name: Shield
description:
A wood-and-metal shield has a central grip and replaceable leather straps.

Provides the 2014 shield bonus of +2 AC when equipped as permitted by the system. Sold with its grip and straps.

weight.notes: Adjusted carried weight for one complete item; 80% of the 2014 baseline.

source.title: Devil's Table: Trade & Merchants
